verdict.rationale: GitLab's REST API and CLI/MCP surfaces (docs-12/13/14, probe-2/3) let an AI-native user script actions 'across multiple projects' and 'across your organization,' which supports bulk-style automation, but there is no explicit documentation of dedicated bulk-operation endpoints (e.g., batch issue/MR updates) or throughput/rate-limit guidance for large-scale AI-driven bulk runs. missing for 10: explicit bulk API endpoints or batch operation docs, rate-limit/performance guidance for large-scale automation, and hands-on evidence of an AI agent successfully performing bulk actions.
